metadata.title: POSM Materials Design
metadata.description: Professional point-of-sale materials design: wobblers, roll-up banners, posters, stickers, shelf strips, table tents and a complete POS kit.

hero.title: POSM Materials Design
hero.subtitle: Catch the shopper in the right place at the right moment.
hero.description: Wobblers, roll-up banners, shelf strips, posters, table tents — professional POSM design that stands out at the point of sale and lifts sales.

problem.title: Weak POSM sends shoppers to a competitor
problem.description: Most brands do not make their products stand out enough at the point of sale. A poor wobbler or a badly made shelf strip hurts the brand image and pushes the shopper towards a competing product.

solution.title: We turn the point of sale into brand space
solution.description: The Jon Branding team designs a set of POSM materials that match your brand style, read well and draw attention. Every piece is built on retail psychology and your brand rules.

included.title: What is included in POSM design?
items: Creative design concept that fits the brand

benefits.title: What does this service give you?
items: You get noticed at the point of sale
Your brand looks professional and trustworthy
The whole retail area in your brand colours and style
You stand out visually from competitors
Your brand works at the checkout and on the shelf

process.title: How do we work?
steps: We study your brand rules and retail format
We define the list of materials and sizes
We develop a POSM design concept that fits the brand
After revisions we deliver print-ready files

tiers.name: STANDARD
features: Wobbler, shelf strip, poster, table tent, flyer

tiers.name: PREMIUM
features: Wobbler, shelf strip, roll-up, poster, table tent, flyer, totem

cta.title: Let your point of sale show your brand strength
cta.description: POSM materials nudge shoppers to choose in the right place. We will prepare a set of good-looking, effective materials that fit your brand.

items.question: What types of materials do you make?
items.answer: Wobblers, shelf strips, roll-up banners, posters, table tents, flyers, brochures, totems (standees), floor stickers and other point-of-sale materials.

items.question: In what format do you deliver files?
items.answer: Print-ready PDF, AI or EPS files in the specified CMYK colours.

items.question: Can we provide our own sizes?
items.answer: Yes, we can work in any size. We also advise on standard sizes.

items.question: Do you design just one material?
items.answer: Yes, you can order individual materials too. The price depends on the material type.

items.question: Can you work fast for a promotion?
items.answer: Yes, there is an express option for urgent orders. We agree on the timeline during the briefing.
